steps.title: Templates
steps.ask: First, on its own: which of the templates' projects do you work on (name each one, even if there's only one)? Then, each template as its own choice: which should be installed as routines, of those of your projects and those for any project? Templates with the same name are alternatives. None are picked by default.
commands: procauto templates list --json   # each template's project (none: for any project); offer only the ones of the projects they work on, and those with none, and only those with supportsBackend (the others need another llm.backend)

steps.title: Model backend
steps.status: Runs with local (experimental, untested), but no model is set: `procauto settings set llm.local.model <model>` (its name on the server, e.g. qwen3:8b)
steps.ask:
Which backend should run your routines?
- claude-code: Claude Code on your Claude subscription (recommended)
- claude-api: Anthropic's API, paid per token
- local: Your own model server, e.g. Ollama (experimental, untested)
- codex: OpenAI's Codex CLI (experimental, untested)
On local: which model should routines run on (its name on your server, e.g. qwen3:8b; `ollama list` shows the ones pulled)? And is the server at http://localhost:11434/v1 (Ollama on this machine), or where is it?
commands: procauto settings set llm.local.url <url>   # local only, experimental and untested: when the server isn't at http://localhost:11434/v1 (Ollama on this machine)
procauto settings set llm.local.model <model>   # local only: the model routines run on, its name on the server (e.g. qwen3:8b)
procauto auth login local --browser   # local only: when the server needs an API key (doctor says so; hosted ones do, Ollama doesn't)
